card.name: Gaps in web page metadata
card.fires_on: Responds to a word or space in web forum and listing text, mostly just before a date, a dash, or the start of the next field. Examples are the word after "Join", a space after a name or number, and "entries" in a search count.

modes.label: Forum join date
modes.description: The word Date or the space after it in a forum member header, right before the date.
modes.example: Not a member yet? Register. - 05-11-2007 #1 - Join<< Date>> - Oct 2006

modes.label: Space after a number or name
modes.description: A blank space after a number, name or word, where a new text field starts.

modes.label: Result counts and numbering
modes.description: A count word or digit in a listing or section number.
modes.example: 17<< entries>> found for ball. The first 1

card.writes: Promotes Chinese web-footer words such as 如有侵权 and 关注 and the word Subscribe, and suppresses "too", so it nudges output toward web-page boilerplate.
card.plain: It fires on small gaps and field labels in scraped web pages, like forum join dates and listing counts.
